items.title: Problems associated with kidney transplant (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Problems associated with kidney transplant: a main subheading of 14.3.4 Kidney Transplant, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-24.

blocks.text: Kidney transplant ke saath kuch mumkina pecheedgiyan (complications) aur khatre hain. Maslan:

items: Recipient ka immune system naye gurde ko bahar ki (foreign) cheez samajh kar us par hamla kar sakta hai, jis se organ rejection (gurda radd hona) hota hai. Yeh tab bhi ho sakta hai jab mareez rejection rokne ke liye immunosuppressant dawaen (immune system ko dabane wali dawaen) le raha ho.
Jin mareezon ka immune system dabaya gaya ho unhen transplant ke baad infections ka khatra zyada hota hai.

Recipients ko organ rejection rokne ke liye immunosuppressant dawaen di jati hain. In dawaon ke side effects ho sakte hain, jaise high blood pressure, wazan barhna, aur infections aur cancers ka zyada khatra.

blocks.caption: Mumkina donors
rows: recipient ka jeeni (genetic) rishtedar, jaise walid ya walida, bhai behan ya aulad; behtareen donor ho sakta hai
jeeni rishtedar nahi, jaise shareek-e-hayat, dost ya saathi karkun; kam aam, magar blood group aur tissue type milen to kamyab ho sakta hai
woh log jo maut ke baad aaza dene ke liye hospitals mein register hote hain; un ke gurde blood group, tissue type aur immune mutabiqat se milaye jate hain

blocks.prompt: Kidney transplant ke mareezon ko immunosuppressant dawayein kyun di jati hain, aur is ki qeemat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke immune system diye gaye gurde ko ajnabi samajh kar radd na kare. Qeemat kamzor difa hai: zyada infections aur cancers, aur high blood pressure aur wazan barhne jaise side effects.

items: Kidney transplant: end-stage kidney failure mein nakara gurde ki jagah donor ka sehatmand gurda.
Donors: related (khooni rishtedar, sab se behtar), unrelated (blood group aur tissue type milen to), deceased (maut ke baad atiya).
Masail: organ rejection, infections, immunosuppressant dawaon ke side effects.
